channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Iranian Foreign Minister visits Turkmenistan for bilateral talks
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi visited Ashgabat with a delegation of diplomatic, economic, and parliamentary representatives. He held talks with Turkmen officials, discussing bilateral relations, regional events, and key economic projects, particularly in the trade and energy sectors. The visit aimed to strengthen partnership between the two countries.

item.title: Turkic States Summit in Ankara Focuses on New Cooperation Avenues and Uzbekistan's Initiatives
item.description: The 13th Summit of the Organization of Turkic States (OTS) in Ankara, themed 'Turkic Century: Unity in Language, Thought, and Action,' aimed to elevate multilateral cooperation. Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev proposed initiatives to deepen ties in trade, economy, investment, transport, logistics, industrial cooperation, and human capital development.

item.title: International Exhibition on Turkmenistan's Industrial Development Opens in Ashgabat
item.description: An international exhibition and conference titled 'Development of Turkmenistan's Construction, Industrial, Chemical, and Energy Sectors' has commenced in Ashgabat. The event aims to enhance the country's industrial capacity, diversify the national economy, create new products for global markets, and increase the capabilities of existing enterprises.

item.title: Uzbekistan Faces Potential Data Breach Affecting Two-Thirds of Population
item.description: A hacker group named Butterfly claims to have obtained personal data of up to 27 million Uzbek citizens from a government database. The group has demanded authorities comply with their terms or the data will be sold. The Uzbek government has not confirmed or denied the alleged hack, which could include names, addresses, and biometric information.

item.title: UN Report Commends Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan for Ecosystem Restoration Efforts
item.description: A UN report highlights Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan's success in restoring degraded ecosystems and aiding endangered species recovery. Kazakhstan is recognized for reviving the Northern Aral Sea, placing it among top global efforts for inland water systems. The report notes that global restoration efforts have created over 1.1 million jobs.

item.title: Kazakhstan Vanadium Project Finds Value in Mining By-Products Like Carbon Black
item.description: Ferro-Alloy Resources is developing a vanadium deposit in Kazakhstan, also recovering molybdenum and nickel. The company is finding additional value in by-products such as its proprietary Carbon Black Substitute (CBS), uranium, and rare earth minerals. These by-products could significantly enhance future earnings beyond the primary vanadium extraction.

item.title: Uzbekistan Launches New System for Safe and Profitable Labor Migration
item.description: Uzbekistan is implementing a new system to ensure safe, orderly, and profitable labor migration. President Shavkat Mirziyoyev visited the Intil center, which provides language and professional training for citizens seeking overseas employment. The center aims to connect training with job placement and facilitate adaptation to new environments.

item.title: Central Asian Judicial Systems Convene for Cybersecurity and AI Training
item.description: Representatives from the judicial systems of Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Turkmenistan are participating in an international training course in Uzbekistan focused on cybersecurity, digital evidence, and artificial intelligence in judicial activities. The event aims to enhance cooperation and share best practices.

item.title: Kazakhstan and China eye joint fund of $200 million for Trans-Caspian transport route
item.description: Kazakhstan's Deputy Prime Minister Serik Zhumangarin discussed the creation of a joint investment fund for the development of the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (TITR) with China's Finance Minister Lan Foan. The proposed fund aims for an initial target volume of up to $200 million.

item.title: Unfavorable Air Quality Expected in 12 Kazakh Cities on November 3
item.description: Kazakhstan's 'Kazgidromet' reports unfavorable meteorological conditions are expected in Almaty and 11 other cities on November 3. These conditions, characterized by calm winds and temperature inversions, can lead to air pollution. Residents are advised to limit outdoor activities, especially vulnerable groups.

item.title: Turkmenistan President Receives Iranian Foreign Minister
item.description: President Serdar Berdimuhamedow of Turkmenistan met with Iran's Foreign Minister, Seyed Abbas Araghchi. Araghchi conveyed greetings from Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and emphasized Iran's commitment to developing relations with Turkmenistan. Both sides highlighted the importance of friendly relations based on mutual respect and trust.

item.title: Kazakhstan Plans Strategic Uranium Reserve of 150,000 Tons by 2050
item.description: Kazakhstan's Atomic Energy Agency plans to establish a strategic uranium reserve of at least 150,000 tons by 2050 to secure fuel for future nuclear power plants. This initiative views uranium not just as raw material but as a strategic asset for economic development.

item.title: Austrian Ambassador Presents Credentials to Turkmenistan President
item.description: At the request of President Serdar Berdimuhamedow, Mejlis Speaker D. Gulmanowa accepted the credentials of the new Austrian Ambassador to Turkmenistan, Etienne Berchtold. The Ambassador conveyed greetings from Austrian President Alexander Van der Bellen and expressed gratitude for the warm welcome. Both sides affirmed commitment to strengthening bilateral cooperation.

item.title: Deputy Mayor of Uralsk Fined 648,000 Tenge for Competition Law Violations
item.description: The deputy mayor of Uralsk has been fined 648,000 tenge for violating competition protection laws. An analysis by the Uralsk city prosecutor's office revealed that the city's housing and utilities department entered into agreements with design organizations for free development of project documentation, later implementing these projects with budget funds.

item.title: Uzbekistan Sets Price for Liquefied Gas and Compensation for Needy Families
item.description: Uzbekistan has established a retail price of 5,000 Uzbek soums per kilogram for liquefied gas supplied to the population. Needy families will receive compensation for up to 20 kilograms of gas monthly. This measure aims to support vulnerable households.

item.title: Turkmenistan advances state cooperation in new directions at Turkic States' summit
item.description: Turkmenistan participated as an observer in the summit of the Organization of Turkic States (OTS). President Serdar Berdimuhamedow planted saplings symbolizing friendship and planted trees at the opening of the Cultural Park. The event included cultural exhibitions and ethno-sport games.

item.title: Turkey Expands Air Connectivity with Uzbekistan, Adding New Routes
item.description: Turkish airline Pegasus Airlines is launching regular flights from Istanbul to Bukhara, Andijan, and Termez in Uzbekistan. The company is also considering flights to Karshi and Nukus. This expansion aims to enhance regional transport accessibility and attract foreign tourists.

item.title: Taliban and Belarus Discuss Expanding Trade Relations and Investment
item.description: The Taliban's Minister of Industry and Commerce, Nooruddin Azizi, met with Belarus's non-resident ambassador to Afghanistan, Alexander Ogorodnikov, to discuss expanding bilateral economic and trade cooperation. Topics included joint trade exhibitions, establishing trade centers, investment opportunities in Afghanistan, and facilitating visas for businesspeople. Belarus expressed readiness to strengthen economic ties.

item.title: Erdogan Sends Telegram to Tokayev While Flying Over Kazakhstan
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan sent a telegram to Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev while flying over Kazakhstan en route to South Korea. Erdogan recalled his state visit to Kazakhstan and Tokayev's recent visit to Ankara, wishing well-being to Tokayev and prosperity to the Kazakh people.

item.title: Global Tech Giants Report Significant Profits from AI Investments
item.description: Major global corporations are now realizing substantial financial gains from their multi-billion dollar investments in artificial intelligence. Reports for the third quarter show AI technologies significantly boosting profitability for companies like Google, Santander, Novartis, Meta, Standard Chartered, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Apple.

item.title: Uzbekistan and Bahrain Discuss Bilateral Cooperation Prospects in Manama
item.description: Uzbekistan and Bahrain held their first round of political consultations in Manama, discussing prospects for strengthening political dialogue and bilateral relations. Both sides focused on expanding trade, economic, and investment cooperation, as well as cultural ties.

item.title: 22 Gas Stations in Nukus Fined for Price Collusion
item.description: Uzbekistan's competition committee has fined 22 gas stations in Nukus for coordinated price increases of liquefied gas. The committee found evidence of collusion after receiving consumer complaints about simultaneous price hikes. The stations collectively raised prices by an average of 1050 soms per cubic meter, violating competition law.

item.title: 17 Kazakh Citizens, Including 11 Children, Hospitalized in Tashkent Due to Food Poisoning
item.description: Seventeen Kazakh citizens, including eleven children, have been hospitalized in Tashkent after falling ill during a children's football tournament. Four are in intensive care. The group reportedly experienced symptoms after breakfast. Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry is monitoring the situation, as parents await test results and arrangements for repatriation.

item.title: Kazakhstan Identifies Systemic Problems in Military Exercises Following Caspian Tragedy
item.description: Kazakhstan's Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov stated that a recent tragedy in the Caspian Sea revealed systemic issues in planning and conducting military exercises. Deficiencies were found in exercise control, risk assessment, and emergency response readiness, with insufficient attention paid to hazardous factors and safety compliance.

item.title: Almaty Hosts Meetings on President Tokayev's Address with Public and Government Representatives
item.description: Meetings were held across Almaty between residents, Kurultai deputies, Kazakhstan People's Council members, and government representatives to explain President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's address. Key topics included the National Fund's use, minimum wage increases, and social infrastructure construction. Public opinions and proposals were gathered.

item.title: Georgian Parliament Speaker Arrives in Kyrgyzstan for Official Visit
item.description: The Speaker of the Parliament of Georgia, Shalva Papuashvili, has arrived in Kyrgyzstan for an official visit. He was met at Manas International Airport by the First Deputy Speaker of the Jogorku Kenesh, Mederbek Aliyev. During his visit, Papuashvili is scheduled to hold several high-level meetings.

item.title: Kazakhstan Foils Attempted Coup, Detains Ten Individuals
item.description: Kazakhstan's National Security Committee reported thwarting a coup attempt in the western region of the country, detaining ten individuals in Atyrau. Authorities allege the suspects planned to violently alter the constitutional order, engaging in extremism, terrorism promotion, and religious incitement. Weapons and religious materials were seized.

item.title: Violations Found in Kazakh Military Training Where 14 Soldiers Drowned
item.description: An investigation following the drowning of 14 soldiers in September in Kazakhstan's Mangystau region has revealed numerous shortcomings in the organization and safety of the military training exercise. The soldiers were swept out to sea during the exercise.

item.title: Russia Simplifies Military-Technical Cooperation with Kyrgyzstan
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has signed a law ratifying a protocol amending the agreement on military-technical cooperation between Russia and Kyrgyzstan. The protocol aims to streamline the process, allowing for direct contracts between authorized organizations without import/export licenses.

item.title: Kazakhstan: Candidates Barred from Local Elections, Kazakhs Repatriating, Protests in Germany
item.description: Several individuals seeking to run in local elections in Kazakhstan were unable to register as candidates. Reports indicate that some ethnic Kazakhs returning to their homeland are now leaving again. Meanwhile, peaceful protests in Germany escalated into disorder.

item.title: IOM Reports Assisting Over 110,000 Returnees from Pakistan to Afghanistan
item.description: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) has assisted more than 110,000 undocumented migrants returning from Pakistan to Afghanistan between January and October 2026. Assistance was provided with European Union support, enabling access to healthcare and essential services for returnees.

item.title: HRW Warns of Rising Child Marriages and Pregnancy Risks in Afghanistan
item.description: Heather Barr of Human Rights Watch warns of increasing child marriages and pregnancy risks in Afghanistan due to restrictions on women's rights, lack of contraception access, and a resurgence of patriarchy. Forced pregnancies and deteriorating maternal healthcare worsen the situation.

item.title: Ukraine President Zelensky Open to Meeting Putin; Russia Suggests Phone Call
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has expressed readiness to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin. A Kremlin aide stated that Putin would respond if Zelensky called him. Moscow has also proposed that Zelensky visit Russia.

item.title: Taliban Supreme Leader Named Among Enemies of Press Freedom by RSF
item.description: Reporters Without Borders (RSF) has listed Taliban Supreme Leader Hibatullah Akhundzada as an 'Enemy of Press Freedom.' The list includes 32 other individuals and entities, such as Vladimir Putin and Elon Musk. RSF states these individuals target press freedom through propaganda, imprisonment, and killing. Akhundzada is in the political category, with RSF noting increased media restrictions in Afghanistan since the Taliban's return to power.

item.title: Erdogan Sends Warm Greetings to Tokayev While Flying Over Kazakhstan
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan sent a telegram to Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev while flying over Kazakhstan en route to South Korea. Erdogan recalled his May state visit to Kazakhstan and Tokayev's recent visit to Ankara, wishing prosperity to the Kazakh people. Tokayev thanked Erdogan for the hospitality in Ankara, expressing confidence in strengthening bilateral ties.

item.title: Ten Suspects Detained in Kazakhstan for Alleged Coup Attempt
item.description: Ten individuals have been detained in Kazakhstan on suspicion of attempting a state coup. The suspects are accused of forming and leading an extremist group, participating in its activities, promoting terrorism, and inciting religious hatred. Further details are available on Daryo.uz.

item.title: Turkish President Erdogan Sends Message to Kazakh President Tokayev While Flying Over Kazakhstan
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan sent a warm message to Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev while flying over Kazakhstan en route to South Korea. Erdogan expressed his best wishes for Tokayev's health and the prosperity of the Kazakh people, recalling their recent meetings. Tokayev responded, emphasizing the strong ties between the two nations.

item.title: Kazakhstan Receives Second Airbus A400M Military Transport Aircraft
item.description: Kazakhstan has received its second Airbus A400M Atlas military transport aircraft, arriving in Almaty from Spain. This addition enhances the Air Force's capabilities for transporting equipment, evacuating civilians, and delivering humanitarian aid. The aircraft can also be used for disaster response and international peacekeeping missions.

item.title: Kyrgyz Interior Minister Awarded Order of Manas First Degree
item.description: Kyrgyzstan's Interior Minister Ulan Niyazbekov has been awarded the Order of Manas First Degree. The award, decided long before the professional holiday, coincides with the Day of Kyrgyz Militia. This state recognition highlights the minister's significant influence beyond media presence.

item.title: Kazakhstan Embassy Details Footballers' Poisoning Incident in Tashkent
item.description: Seventeen participants of the Dostlik Cup 2026 football festival, who arrived from Karaganda, sought medical attention in Tashkent. The Kazakhstan Embassy in Uzbekistan reported that 17 individuals, including 11 children and 6 adults, are hospitalized. Their condition is stable, and they are receiving medical care. The Kazakh ambassador is monitoring the situation.
